# Baseten

Fast hosted open models (Model APIs).

| | |
|---|---|
| Kind | Chat API (OpenAI-compatible): returns code that conductor-ai applies |
| Cost | Paid, per token |
| Key | `BASETEN_API_KEY` from https://app.baseten.co/settings/api_keys |
| Endpoint | `https://inference.baseten.co/v1` |
| Default model | picked automatically from the live list (coding models first); choose your own with `conductor-ai models baseten --all` |
| conductor-ai name | `baseten` |
| Provider docs | https://docs.baseten.co/development/model-apis/overview |
| Checked | 2026-11 |

## Set up

1. Create an API key: https://app.baseten.co/settings/api_keys
2. Add it to conductor-ai. It asks for the key (hidden input), lets you pick a model, sends one test prompt and adds it to the `docs`, `test`, `review` and `ask` roles:
   ```bash
   conductor-ai add baseten
   ```
3. Check it any time:
   ```bash
   conductor-ai doctor --live
   ```

Or click **Add** on its card in `conductor-ai ui` → Providers.

## Without the wizard

Save the key (hidden input; or pipe it in):
```bash
conductor-ai keys set BASETEN_API_KEY
```

Then add this to `~/.config/conductor-ai/config.json` (all projects) or `.conductor-ai/config.json` (one project):
```json
{
  "providers": {
    "baseten": {
      "type": "openai",
      "enabled": true,
      "baseUrl": "https://inference.baseten.co/v1",
      "apiKeyEnv": "BASETEN_API_KEY",
      "model": "<model id>"
    }
  }
}
```
List models: `conductor-ai models baseten --all`. Put `baseten` in any role's chain in `conductor-ai ui` → Roles & fallback.

The variable name only tells conductor-ai where to find the key; the provider never sees it. To use a key you already keep under another name, set `"apiKeyEnv": "YOUR_VAR"` on `baseten`.

## Troubleshooting

- **401 / 403**: the key is wrong, expired, or still a placeholder. Run `conductor-ai keys` to see where it comes from, then `conductor-ai keys set BASETEN_API_KEY`.
- **404 or "model not found"**: the model id changed. Pick a current one with `conductor-ai models baseten --all`.
- **429**: rate limit. conductor-ai puts the provider on cooldown and moves to the next one in the chain; `conductor-ai cooldown --clear baseten` resets it.
- **Empty reply**: some free routes return nothing now and then; conductor-ai retries once, then falls back.
